versionId.description: The version identifier is a customer-specific identifier used to distinguish one version of the SETU Inquiry Pay Equity message from another.

issued.description: The datetime the document was issued.

Id.description: A unique identifier of this specific leave line element.

BaseAmount.description: This element stores information about the base over which the amount is calculated. If the value is 3, the unit code is 'Percentage' and the base code is 'MonthlyRate', and the basetype is `GrossSalary` together they would imply a 3% of monthly gross salary.

value.description: This element can be used to store additional information about the value of the base if applicable.

minValue.description:
If applicable, a minimum value can be provided to signify a minimum that the value in this base has to be. This implies that if the value is less than the minimum value, the minimum value will be used instead of the value element. 

If the amount of the monthly rate of the gross salary is 3000 (which is the monthly salary) and the min value of the base amount is 4000, the 4000 would be used as the value.

maxValue.description:
If applicable, a maximum value can be provided to signify a maximum that the value in this base has to be. This implies that if the value is max than the maximum value, the maximum value will be used instead of the value element. 

If the amount of the monthly rate of the gross salary is 3000 (which is the monthly salary) and the max value is 2000, the 2000 would be used as the value.

Proportional.description: The proportional element is used to specify whether certain work-related conditions such as leave entitlements, remuneration, or similar employment provisions are applied proportionally based on specific employee characteristics.

description.description: A free-text field for capturing any additional details, clarifications, or contextual information relevant to how the proportional rule is applied.

partTimePercentage.description: Indicates whether the condition is calculated proportionally based on the employee’s part‑time percentage, typically measured against a full‑time work week (commonly 36-40 hours).

employmentDuration.description: Indicates whether proportional calculation must be applied according to the employee's length of employment.

Amount.description: Container element that contains the value of the amount, the type of unit of the value and a base. These three elements together can be used to calculate the amount of any type of rate. If applicable, a minimum and a maximum value can also be provided to signify a minimum and maximum that this rate provides. This implies that if the amount as a combination of the value and the base and the unit code is less than the minimum value, the minimum value will replace the value element.

value.description: The numerical value of the remuneration amount expressed as decimal. The unit type of this value can be specified in the unit code element.

minValue.description: If applicable, a minimum value can be provided to signify a minimum that this rate provides. This implies that if the amount as a combination of the value and the base and the unit code is less than the minimum value, the minimum value will be used instead of the value element.

maxValue.description: If applicable, a maximum value can be provided to signify a maximum that this rate provides. This implies that if the amount as a combination of the value and the base and the unit code is less than the maximum value, the maximum value will be used instead of the value element.

Interval.description: This element is used to signify the interval in which this rate is applied. If this rate is applied every hour then the unit code would be 'Hour' or if this rate is applied every kilometer, the interval code would be 'Kilometer'. The value can be used to express denominations of the provided interval code. If for instance it is required that the interval is every 15 minutes, the unit code can be 'Hour' and the value will be 0.25 as a quarter of 60 minutes is 15 minutes.

value.description: The value can be used to express denominations of the provided interval code.

AgeCondition.description: Condition based on age of the employee. The unit is always in years. Decimals are allowed (e.g. 18.5 years).

age.description: The age of the employee in years. The unit is always in years. Decimals are allowed (e.g. 18.5 years).

EmploymentDurationCondition.description: Condition based on the duration of employment of the employee.

duration.description: Duration of the employment expressed according to ISO 8601-1 duration format.

referenceDateType.description: Which start date type of the employment to consider for determining the duration.

Single.description: Single occurrence, e.g. a fixed date.

date.description: Point in time according to ISO 8601-1 format.

Recurring.description: Recurring occurrence, e.g. a weekly or monthly event.

recurringInterval.description: Recurring time interval according to ISO 8601-1 format.

Relative.description: Single occurrence relative to an event.

event.description: Type of event the occurrence is relative to.

offset.description: The offset of the occurrence relative to an event. Time interval expressed according to ISO 8601-1 duration format. Use minus sign for negative offsets. Use 'PT0S' or 'P0D' to indicate no offset.

eventName.description: Short description of the event if 'OtherEvent' is selected as event type.

Occurrence.description: Base type for occurrences with different occurrence types.

OccurrenceCondition.description: A condition based on time or an event.

PositionProfileCondition.description: Condition based on salary scale and optionally step within that scale.

positionProfileIds.description:
List of position profiles to compare against. The condition is met when the employee's position profile
matches any of the position profiles in this list.

items.description:
Reference to the identifier of the position profile.
Must match value in element 'Inquiry Pay Equity/position profile/position id /value'.

SalaryScaleCondition.description: Condition based on salary scale and optionally step within that scale.

salaryScale.description:
Reference to name of the salary scale (e.g. 'FWG-10' of 'Schaal 10').
Must match value in element 'Inquiry Pay Equity/remuneration/salary scale/name'

step.description:
Optional reference to the name of the step within the scale (e.g. 'Trede 5').
Must match value in element 'Inquiry Pay Equity/remuneration/salary scale/salary step/name'

TextCondition.description: A textual condition. Only use this one when a condition cannot be specified by means of the other condition types.

description.description: Full specification of the condition in natural language.

examples.description: Employee has completed a training program on workplace safety.
Employee is eligible for a bonus if the company meets its annual revenue targets.

Condition.description: Abstract condition object. Can be used to include different concrete condition types based on 'conditionType' discriminator property.

AllOfCondition.description: Combition of conditions that ALL must evaluate to true

AnyOfCondition.description: Combition of conditions where at least one must evaluate to true

IkbReference.description: Container element to refer how a renumeration element connects to 'het Individueel Keuze Budget' (EN: Individual Choice Budget).

description.description: A free text-field for additional information and/or context about the ikb reference.

relationType.description: Provides the relationship between the line element and the IKB.

id.description: The unique identifier that references a specific arrangement or a specific rule within an arrangement.

AmountLeaveDay.description: The financial equivalent of one special leave day. It reflects the cost or compensation value of a single day off from work.

value.description: The numerical value of the financial equivalent of one leave day. It reflects the cost or compensation value of a single day off from work.

minValue.description: If applicable, a minimum value can be provided to signify a minimum that this rate provides. This implies that if the amount as a combination of the value and the base and the unit code is less than the minimum value, the minimum value will be used instead of the value element.

maxValue.description: If applicable, a maximum value can be provided to signify a maximum that this rate provides. This implies that if the amount as a combination of the value and the base and the unit code is less than the maximum value, the maximum value will be used instead of the value element.

DatePeriod.description: Single period spanning from the start date up and including to the end date. If both start and end is provided, the date period element indicates a range of dates. If only the start date is provided, the date period element only indicates this singular date.

TimePeriod.description:
The time period during which the allowance is applicable. This period spans from the start time up and including to the end time. 

In the event that multiple time periods are required, multiple period elements can be provided.

WeekdayCode.description: The day in the week to which the allowance is applicable.

PersonName.description: A component for capturing summary or fine-grain data comprising a person's name.

useCode.description: Code identifying the usage of the contact point e.g. business, private, etc.

Communication.description: The communication channels (phone, email) to contact and reach the contact person.

Identifier.description: The unique identifier of this arrangement.

LabourAgreementReference.description: Specifies the origin of the applicable agreement.

ArrangementLineLeave.description: Leave granted for specific, non-routine circumstances as defined by the employer or applicable Collective Labour Agreement, such as bereavement, marriage, or relocation. The specific reasons and duration of special leave may vary.

description.description: A free‑text field for capturing additional details related to reward element (NL: beloningscomponent), such as specifics, limitations and other conditions.

name.description: The name of the special leave

MandatoryLeave.description: A policy mandating that employees utilize a certain amount of their accrued leave within a specified period.

description.description: Description of the mandatory leave allocation.

ArrangementLineLimited.description: A container that contains the details of the increase rate. It includes elements such as the amount that is provided (3% of yearly salary), the interval in which this is applied in the specified period (e.g. each year) and any conditions that might have to be met for this rate to be applicable.

AmountLimited.description: The value of the work duration in hours, expressed as decimal.

WorkDuration.description: Specifies the default work duration. This consists of an amount block indicating the number of hours, an interval block specifying the period over which these hours apply, and a valuePerWeek field indicating the equivalent number of hours per week, useful for calculations such as leave entitlement.

valuePerWeek.description: The equivalent number of hours per week, useful for calculations such as leave entitlement.

HourlyWageConversion.description: Information about the conversion to regular hourly wages.

hourlyWageFactor.description:
A number used to calculate the hourly wage from a periodic salary (e.g., monthly salary). The periodic salary is divided by this factor to determine the hourly wage. 

Formula: hourly wage = periodic salary / hourlyWageFactor.

hourlyWagePercentage.description:
A percentage that the periodic salary (such as a monthly salary) is multiplied by to calculate the hourly wage.

Formula: hourly wage = (periodic salary * hourlyWagePercentage) / 100.

SalaryScaleStep.description: Specifies the steps within each salary scale, where each step has a name/label, a salary value, and possible conditions.

name.description: The name or label of the salary step. E.g., 1,2,3.

value.description: The value of the salary scale step.

minimumWage.description: A boolean that indicates whether this salary step is equal to the minimum wage.

CareerLevel.description: Indicates whether work experience is considered in the salary scale, with a true or false value and a possible description.

description.description: Description of the career levels.

indicator.description: A boolean indicating the presence of taking into account classification of career levels.

PositionProfileReference.description: Specifies the position profile that this salary scale is applied to. This element refers to the 'positionId/value' element in the corresponding position profile.

description.description: A free-text field for capturing additional details related to the remuneration starting position (NL: inschaling), such as exceptions, special conditions, or justifications influencing the initial salary step or profile assignment.

positionId.description: A unique identifier referencing the specific role or job profile as defined in the organization’s salary structure (NL: Salarishuis). This ID enables consistent linkage between the employee’s position and the corresponding salary scale and classification rules.

startSalaryStep.description: A code or numeric value indicating the initial salary step assigned to the role or employee upon entry into the salary scale. It defines the starting point within the organization’s structured salary progression.

SalaryScale.description: Base salary of a job or of an employee including minimum and maximum salary and certain salary steps.

name.description: The name or label of the salary scale. E.g., 1,2,3.

minValue.description: The minimum value of the salary scale.

maxValue.description: The maximum value of the salary scale.

currency.description: The three-letter currency code defined by the ISO 4217 standard (e.g., “EUR”, “USD”).

IndividualSalaryIncrease.description: The individual salary review is a process where an employee's salary is evaluated and adjusted based on individual performance, and other relevant criteria. This container specifies the increase rate of these adjustments.

GeneralSalaryIncrease.description: The general salary adjustment refers to the increase applied uniformly to the entire salary table. This adjustment ensures that all employees receive a consistent percentage or fixed increase in their salaries. Please mind the usage note when to use this container.

description.description: Free text description of the general salary table increase.

amount.description: Container element that contains the value of the amount and the type of unit of the value.

value.description: The numerical value of the remuneration amount expressed as decimal. The unit type of this value can be specified in the unit code element.

ArrangementLine.description: A container that contains the details of the rate in which this pension is provided to the employee. It includes elements such as the amount that is provided (3% of monthly salary), the interval in which this is applied in the specified period (e.g. 'Hour' for an hourly application) and any conditions that might have to be met for this rate to be applicable.

Franchise.description: Indicator whether an employer makes use of a franchise.

description.description: Free text description of the franchise.

CollectiveLabourAgreement.description: Information about the collective labour agreement (CLA; CAO in Dutch) that determines the renumeration. In the Netherlands this can be the CLA of the ABU, NBBU or a specific CLA of the staffing customer.

name.description: The name of the collective labour agreement (CLA).

id.description: The identifier of the collective labour agreement (CLA).

basedOn.description: A collective labour agreement (CLA) applies if the employer is a member of the industry association, if the CLA has been declared generally binding for the sector by the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment, or if it is declared applicable in the employee's employment contract.

AllowanceReference.description: A list of allowances that are included in this base.

WaitingDays.description: The amount of waiting days (NL: wachtdagen) that the worker is subjected to before being eligible to receive sick pay.

value.description: The value of the amount expressed in number of days.

IndividualChoiceBudgetOption.description: Associates the different rates on how this individual choice budget can be spent (e.g. the percentage of salary that one extra day of vacation costs).

description.description: Detailed free text description on the method in which this budget can be spent by an employee.

ContactPerson.description: Specific people at the party who are contacts. This is the person authorized to provide the information.

roleCode.description: The role of the contact person. In this case the inquiry pay equity is authorized by this contact person.

Period.description: A container element that specifies the time period(s) during which the allowance is applicable. It includes a date period (which can be used for date ranges or individual dates), a time period (given the selected dates, this lets us specify the allowed times) and a weekday element that lets us specify recurring days of the week.

AllowanceReferenceExtended.description: This element is used indicate relations to other elements of this structure. An example of such a relation could be that an allowance is used to calculate another allowance on a compounding basis. Meaning that the the value of allowance A is calculated before and used in the calculation of the value of allowance B.

description.description: A description of the nature of the relation.

id.description: The unique identifier that references a specific arrangement or a specific rule within an arrangement.

relationType.description: The code of the type of relation that this reference is.

items.description: A government assigned identifier to distinguish the party (organization, person, or legal entity) to a transaction.

BaseDefinition.description: Definitions of the bases (in Dutch: 'Grondslagen') that can be used to calculate the different rates.

remunerationIndicator.description: This element can be used to indicate whether remuneration(s) is/are taken into consideration for calculating this base.

holidayAllowanceIndicator.description: This element can be used to indicate whether holiday allowance(s) is/are taken into consideration for calculating this base.

paidLeaveDayIndicator.description: This element can be used to indicate whether paid leave days are taken into consideration for calculating this base.

allAllowancesIndicator.description: This element can be used to indicate whether allowances are taken into consideration for calculating this base. If 'True', then all allowances are taken into account. If 'False', the allowances that are taken into account can be specified in the 'allowances' element.

LabourAgreements.description: This container indicates in which sector the staffing customer works and which specific collective labour agreement (CLA) and/or the own employment conditions scheme is leading for the provision of remuneration information.

items.description: The types of industry to which the organization belongs. The industry identifiers should use the CBS - SBI 2008 (Standaard Bedrijfsindeling).

customLabourAgreement.description: Indicator to determine whether a custom labour agreement is active.

PositionProfile.description: These are the position profiles for which the inquiry pay equity applies. From the salary table and other arrangements, you can also use these positions for the conditions of those arrangements.

positionId.description: The primary identifier of the position profile, typically from the system of record.

referenceTitle.description: This reference title provides a reference to the function/role as defined within the Collective Labour Agreement (CAO).

workDescription.description: The free text description of the work that this position normally requires.

RemunerationPackage.description: Details about the remuneration package, including salary tables based on the work duration. It includes one or more salary tables for a specific work duration or characteristics.

AllowanceArrangement.description: A container element that includes various allowances that can be granted to an employee.

description.description: A free‑text field for capturing additional details related to reward element (NL: beloningscomponent), such as specifics, limitations and other conditions.

name.description: The name or description of the arrangement, indicating the type of arrangement and providing extra information that does not fit in any of the other fields.

phaseOutScheme.description: If this allowance has a phasing out scheme arrangement, this can be described in this element.

HolidayAllowanceArrangement.description: A container that contains the details of the holiday allowance arrangement.

description.description: A free‑text field for capturing additional details related to reward element (NL: beloningscomponent), such as specifics, limitations and other conditions.

name.description: The name or description of the arrangement, indicating the type of arrangement and providing extra information that does not fit in any of the other fields.

SickPayArrangement.description: This element refers to the method in which the employer continues to compensate an employee when the employee has fallen ill.

description.description: A free‑text field for capturing additional details related to reward element (NL: beloningscomponent), such as specifics, limitations and other conditions.

name.description: The name or description of the arrangement, indicating the type of arrangement and providing extra information that does not fit in any of the other fields.

LeaveArrangement.description: A container that contains the details of the leave arrangement, such as the type of leave, the amount of the leave, as well as any conditions.

description.description: A free‑text field for capturing additional details related to reward element (NL: beloningscomponent), such as specifics, limitations and other conditions.

name.description: The name or description of the arrangement, indicating the type of arrangement and providing extra information that does not fit in any of the other fields.

IndividualChoiceBudgetArrangement.description: Individual choice budget (Dutch: IKB) is used if the employer has an individual choice budget. It's elements are used for the different options an employee has regarding this budget as well as its costs.

description.description: A free‑text field for capturing additional details related to reward element (NL: beloningscomponent), such as specifics, limitations and other conditions.

name.description: The name or description of the arrangement, indicating the type of arrangement and providing extra information that does not fit in any of the other fields.

PensionArrangement.description: The employer's contribution to a pension plan.

description.description: A free‑text field for capturing additional details related to reward element (NL: beloningscomponent), such as specifics, limitations and other conditions.

name.description: The name or description of the arrangement, indicating the type of arrangement and providing extra information that does not fit in any of the other fields.

SustainableEmployabilityArrangement.description: Sustainable employability allows for the employer to add information regarding sustainable employability arrangement that the employer might have (e.g. study budget for the employee).

description.description: A free‑text field for capturing additional details related to reward element (NL: beloningscomponent), such as specifics, limitations and other conditions.

name.description: The name or description of the arrangement, indicating the type of arrangement and providing extra information that does not fit in any of the other fields.

SupplementaryArrangement.description: A container that specifies the supplementary arrangement(s) (In Dutch: 'aanvullende regelingen').

description.description: The description of the supplementary arrangement.

name.description: The name or description of the arrangement, indicating the type of arrangement and providing extra information that does not fit in any of the other fields.

OtherArrangement.description: This element can be used to provide any additional arrangements that have not been covered by the other elements.

description.description: A free‑text field for capturing additional details related to reward element (NL: beloningscomponent), such as specifics, limitations and other conditions.

name.description: The name or description of the arrangement, indicating the type of arrangement and providing extra information that does not fit in any of the other fields.
